reasons: Accessorial code 'OTHER' for fuel is not listed in Schedule C; therefore the $515.5 fuel surcharge is not payable.
Billed weight (386,550 lbs) is vastly higher than the BOL weight (18,340 lbs) and no reweigh certificate is provided; weight-based charges beyond the contract linehaul are not supported.
All other linehaul charges ($3350) match the contract rate for the lane (895xx -> 802xx).
decision.dispute_summary: Fuel surcharge is not authorized (accessorial code OTHER not listed in Schedule C) and weight on invoice far exceeds BOL weight without a reweigh certificate.
